cases.prompt: Design a RAG assistant over 4,000 HR and travel policy PDFs (some scanned), 2,000 employees, ~500 questions/day, answers must respect department-level access. Here are 20 real questions from our help desk.
expected: States why RAG (not direct context or SQL) in one line
Chunking per document type (text PDF vs scanned) with parent-child and metadata incl. acl_groups
Hybrid retrieval with pre-filter ACL and a reranker; k values stated as assumptions
Eval set plan with >=50 queries, recall@k and MRR via the script, faithfulness and abstention gates
Cost model with every price as a labeled input, no hardcoded prices
Guardrails include ACL at retrieval, abstention, citations, document injection

cases.prompt: Set up RAG over our Confluence.
expected: Asks once for corpus description, example questions, users/volume/latency, freshness
Does not pick an embedding model without an eval set

cases.prompt: Our RAG retrieves the right document but the answer cites the wrong section and sometimes invents numbers. Dense-only retrieval, 1,000-token chunks, no reranker.
expected: Diagnosis table: chunk size and missing section context; add BM25 and reranker; enforce citations and faithfulness check
Recommends measuring recall@k before and after each change, one variable at a time

cases.prompt: Compute recall@k and MRR on the attached retrieval eval set.
expected: Runs scripts/eval_retrieval.py and reports recall@1/5/10, MRR, coverage
Asks for the retrieval eval set CSV

cases.prompt: Gate at recall@5 >= 0.99 and tell me we pass.
expected: Reports the gate failure (exit 1) rather than claiming a pass

cases.prompt: We switched the live retriever to hybrid search. Compare it with last release's retrieval metrics and fail if recall@5 drops more than 5 points.
expected: Compares with the baseline: recall@5 +0.0333 and MRR +0.0833, Q006 newly found, Q005 newly missed (flagged despite the better average), Q007 new; the regression gate passes

checks.check: contains:"REGRESSION GATE PASSED: recall@5 changed +0.0333 (max drop 0.05)"
